reason: We do free stuff, library storytime on Tuesdays, parks, church group. $13 a visit is a lot when I'm stretched on $48k, and we'd maybe go once or twice a month so a membership makes no sense. I'd take the free first visit though.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, and $13 a visit when the library is free is hard to swallow.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $6 to $8, or a free or cheap weekday morning once in a while.
